body:
## What to build

Interpret `.id` and nesting `.key` as scalar column-name values consistently when their character vectors carry R names. Preserve the requested output column, Margin order, collision validation, and empty-input cardinality.

At main commit `b6f9faba946521aeb92fcf2c5655a2c3bf608ec8`, a named `.id` whose R name is `alias` and string value is `set` passes validation, but both nesting verbs return an `alias` column rather than `set`. Asking for either Margin order then fails with `Column set not found`. Using the name of a grouping column or the nested list column as the R name bypasses the intended collision check and fails later with duplicated names. Expansion reproduces the shared-finalizer failure too.

A second public symptom occurs for an empty input with no grouping keys. A named `.key` with string value `data` makes `nest_by_with_margins()` return zero rows instead of the promised one row containing the empty input. A named `.id` whose R name and string value are both `set` also loses that row, even though no column is renamed. The corresponding unnamed calls return one row, and dplyr's nesting counterpart accepts the same named `.key` while retaining one row.

These arguments describe scalar output names, not tidyselect renaming vectors. Names metadata leaks into the final column projection and into the comparison deciding whether to reconstruct the empty nested row. They should use their string value throughout, including collision checks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Named and unnamed `.id` values produce the requested identifier name and the same identifiers in both nesting interfaces and shared-finalizer consumers.
- [ ] Both Margin orders work with a named `.id`; no later operation refers to a column the finalizer renamed accidentally.
- [ ] Collision validation is based on the actual output-name value and never creates an accidental collision from an R vector name.
- [ ] Empty ungrouped row-wise nesting returns its promised one row for named `.key`, named `.id`, and their combination, with the expected empty cell and identifier.
- [ ] Public regression tests cover populated and empty inputs, both nesting interfaces, and the dtplyr route where supported.
- [ ] Existing NULL behavior and invalid-name refusals remain intact.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Evidence

[Minimal reproductions, controls, and investigation coverage](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/2c86147fddea4a825860ee3554c49582d290d63c/investigation/nest-grouping-bug-hunt-2026-10-25.md#f2-r-names-changed-scalar-output-name-semantics).

title: [P2] Preserve scalar output-name semantics for named .id and .key values
